unitTitle: Future Simple - Be going to - Present Continuous - Conditionals Type 1 - When/If

pairsWith.noteUz: Bu nazariya beti Coursebook 5-unit (Planning Ahead) grammatikasini takrorlaydi: will va be going to.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 5-UNIT NAZARIYA (24-bet, PDF 23). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '5', sarlavha: 'Future Simple - Be going to - Present Continuous - Conditionals Type 1 - When/If'. Och pushti ramka.

'Future Simple' JADVALI: Affirmative - Long form: I will go, he/she/it will go, we/you/they will go; Short form: I'll go, he/she/it'll go, we/you/they'll go. Interrogative: Will I go? Will he/she/it go? Will we/you/they go? Negative - Long form: I will not go, he/she/it will not go, we/you/they will not go; Short form: I won't go, he/she/it won't go, we/you/they won't go.
'Form': • We form the future simple with will + the base form of the verb. 'She will visit us. They will have a party.' • We form the interrogative by putting will before the subject pronoun. 'Will she visit us? Will they have a party?' • We form the negative by putting not after will. 'She will not/won't visit us. They will not/won't have a party.'
'Use': We use the future simple: • for predictions based on what we believe or think. 'Robots will do most of the work in the future.' • for on-the-spot decisions or promises. 'A: It's cold in here. B: I'll close the window. Your father will help you with your homework.' • we use Will you ...? to ask someone to do something for us (request). 'Will you post this letter for me, please?'
'Short answers': Yes, I/you/he, etc will. No, I/you/he, etc won't.
'Time expressions we use with the future simple': tomorrow, the day after tomorrow, next week/month/year, tonight, soon, in a week/month/year, etc.

'Be going to' JADVALI: Affirmative - Long form: I am going to travel. He/She/It is going to travel. We/You/They are going to travel. Short form: I'm going to travel. He/She/It's going to travel. We/You/They're going to travel. Interrogative: Am I going to travel? Is he/she/it going to travel? Are we/you/they going to travel? Negative - Long form: I am not going to travel. He/She/It is not going to travel. We/You/They are not going to travel. Short form: I'm not going to travel. He/She/It isn't going to travel. We/You/They aren't going to travel.
'Form': • We form the affirmative with the verb to be (am, is, are) going to + the base form of the verb. 'He is going to have a snack.' • We form the interrogative by putting the verb to be before the subject pronoun. 'Is he going to have a snack?' • We form the negative by putting not after the verb to be. 'He is not/isn't going to have a snack.'
'Short answers': Yes, I am/you are/he is, etc. No, I'm not/you aren't/he isn't, etc.
'Use': We use be going to: • for plans and intentions we have for the near future. 'Susan is going to move house.'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '24'.

exercises.instructionEn: Affirmative: I/he/she/it/we/you/they will go (I'll go, he'll go ...). Interrogative: Will I/he/we ... go? Negative: will not go / won't go. Form: will + the base form of the verb: She will visit us. They will have a party. Interrogative: will before the subject: Will she visit us? Negative: not after will: She won't visit us. Use: for predictions based on what we believe or think: Robots will do most of the work in the future; for on-the-spot decisions or promises: A: It's cold in here. B: I'll close the window. Your father will help you with your homework; Will you ...? to ask someone to do something for us (request): Will you post this letter for me, please? Short answers: Yes, I will. / No, I won't. Time expressions: tomorrow, the day after tomorrow, next week/month/year, tonight, soon, in a week/month/year.
exercises.instructionUz: Tasdiq: I/he/she/it/we/you/they will go (I'll go, he'll go ...). So'roq: Will I/he/we ... go? Inkor: will not go / won't go. Shakl: will + fe'l asosiy shakli: U bizni ziyorat qiladi. Ular ziyofat qiladi. So'roq: will egadan oldin: U bizni ziyorat qiladimi? Inkor: will dan keyin not: U bizni ziyorat qilmaydi. Ishlatilishi: fikrga asoslangan bashorat: Kelajakda ishlarning ko'pini robotlar qiladi; shu zahoti qabul qilingan qaror yoki va'da: A: Bu yer sovuq. B: Men derazani yopaman. Otang uy vazifangda yordam beradi; Will you ...? - iltimos (so'rov): Bu xatni men uchun jo'natib yuborasizmi? Qisqa javob: Yes, I will. / No, I won't. Vaqt so'zlari: tomorrow, the day after tomorrow, next week/month/year, tonight, soon, in a week/month/year.
exercises.explanationUz:
FUTURE SIMPLE = WILL + FE'L.

  TASDIQ: I / he / they WILL go
    (hamma shaxsda bir xil)
    Qisqa: I'll, he'll, they'll
  SO'ROQ: WILL she visit us?
  INKOR: She WILL NOT / WON'T
    visit us.
  QISQA JAVOB: Yes, I will. / No,
    I won't.


QAChON - 3 HOLAT:

  1) BAShORAT (fikr):
     Robots WILL DO most of the
     work in the future.

  2) ShU ZAHOTI QAROR / VA'DA:
     A: It's cold in here.
     B: I'LL CLOSE the window.
     (hozir qaror qildim)
     Your father WILL HELP you.
     (va'da)

  3) ILTIMOS - Will you ...?
     WILL YOU post this letter for
     me, please?


VAQT SO'ZLARI:

  tomorrow, the day after tomorrow
  (indinga), next week / month /
  year, tonight, soon (tez orada),
  in a week (bir haftadan keyin)


⚠ 'WILL' DAN KEYIN 'TO' YO'Q:

  'will to go' ✗, 'will goes' ✗.

exercises.instructionEn: Affirmative: I am (I'm) going to travel. He/She/It is ('s) going to travel. We/You/They are ('re) going to travel. Interrogative: Am I going to travel? Is he going to travel? Are they going to travel? Negative: I'm not going to travel. He isn't going to travel. They aren't going to travel. Form: to be (am, is, are) + going to + base form: He is going to have a snack. Interrogative: to be before the subject: Is he going to have a snack? Negative: not after to be: He isn't going to have a snack. Short answers: Yes, I am / you are / he is. No, I'm not / you aren't / he isn't. Use: for plans and intentions we have for the near future: Susan is going to move house.
exercises.instructionUz: Tasdiq: I am (I'm) going to travel. He/She/It is ('s) going to travel. We/You/They are ('re) going to travel. So'roq: Am I going to travel? Is he going to travel? Are they going to travel? Inkor: I'm not going to travel. He isn't going to travel. They aren't going to travel. Shakl: to be (am, is, are) + going to + fe'l asosiy shakli: U yengil tamaddi qilmoqchi. So'roq: to be egadan oldin: U tamaddi qilmoqchimi? Inkor: to be dan keyin not: U tamaddi qilmoqchi emas. Qisqa javob: Yes, I am / you are / he is. No, I'm not / you aren't / he isn't. Ishlatilishi: yaqin kelajakdagi reja va niyatlar uchun: Syuzan ko'chmoqchi.
exercises.explanationUz:
BE GOING TO = am / is / are +
  going to + FE'L.

  TASDIQ: He IS GOING TO have a
    snack. (U tamaddi qilmoqchi)
  SO'ROQ: IS he going to have a
    snack?
  INKOR: He ISN'T going to have a
    snack.
  QISQA JAVOB: Yes, he is. / No,
    he isn't.


QAChON:

  REJA va NIYAT (oldindan
  o'ylangan):
    Susan IS GOING TO move house.
    (Syuzan ko'chmoqchi - reja)


⚠ WILL va GOING TO FARQI:

  WILL - shu zahoti qaror:
    'It's cold. I'LL close the
    window.'
  GOING TO - oldindan reja:
    'I'M GOING TO close the window
    - I decided this morning.'


⚠ O'ZBEKChA:

  going to = '-moqchi'
  will = '-adi' / '-aman'
